summary: Fixed Unicode Bidi control character sanitization by extending _sanitize_text to handle U+200E-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, and U+2066-U+2069 ranges
risks: Bidi chars now escaped with \uNNNN format instead of passing through - may change output for existing users with Bidi chars in todo text
mitigation: This is a security fix - preventing potential text spoofing attacks outweighs output change concerns
Output change is minimal - only affects edge case of Bidi chars in todo text
